This package answers that package's open question 1 only: prove A=0 by showing the charged finite stock has no atom-width factor, contrasting the ordinary BIT digit-tower lift.

stop_rule: Stop after proving A=0 with B_bits=2642 under the named finite-stock-as-C admission, with ordinary contrast and mutation controls. Do not recompute Sp(72,2) bit length as a contribution, do not bind rho, do not import 57604 or 252, and do not claim a full sigma envelope.
evidence: verify.py and independent.py (PASS_SELECTED_STOCK_SHAPE_A_ZERO) prove A=0 and shape_B_bits=2642 for the selected m=73 complex producer under the finite-stock-as-C reading already named in selected-coarse-depth-stock/PROOF.md. The ordinary BIT cover forces A>=4096 via |GL_m(Z/q^w Z)| = |GL_m(F_q)| q^{m^2(w-1)}; the complex cover's Sp->O lifts are F_2 parameters (u,c) and the selected Sp(72,2) x 14826 stock has no atom-width factor.
